notes: Captured from the live Digitraffic Marine AIS API (locations and vessels, with a Digitraffic-User header) and trimmed: 600 vessels whose position was less than nine minutes old at capture, plus 12 vessels whose last position was more than an hour old (kept to exercise the 60-minute filter), and the metadata rows of exactly those vessels. RE-TIMED: every timestamp (dataUpdatedTime, timestampExternal, metadata timestamp) was shifted forward by exactly 366 minutes so that dataUpdatedTime is 2026-11-10T23:59:32Z and all current positions fall within the ten minutes before the fixture epoch; a whole-minute shift keeps the AIS 'UTC second' field consistent. Nothing else was changed. The malformed variants of both routes were authored by hand.
